baseline_invocation_s.source: results/reproduce/out/run/ensemble.json measured total_wall_s=58.41479131799997 s for all eight seeds 1000..1007 at 25000 steps each. Process launch-to-exit wall was not recorded. Estimate one complete invocation as 2 * 58.41479131799997 = 116.82958263599994 s: measured ensemble time plus an equal-sized conservative prospective allowance for excluded launch/import/input/serialization costs. Factor 2 is an explicit unmeasured allowance, not a process-wall measurement; no reduction to fit budget. Adapter smoke must verify real cost.

confidence_rule.decision: Performance: exact one-sided binomial order-statistic lower bound for median baseline/candidate wall-time ratio; require lower bound >1.05. Five independent timing pairs give minimum ratio as finite conservative lower bound, coverage 1-2^-5=0.96875. Equivalence: exact two-sided binomial order-statistic bounds, Bonferroni across two metrics, per-metric alpha=0.025 with alpha/2=0.0125 per tail. Eight seeds give min/max finite CI, coverage 1-2*2^-8=0.9921875 per metric. Require both CIs within (-margin,+margin). Lack of significance is not equivalence. Declare success only if scientific and performance rules both pass.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular dynamics benchmark has no calibrated monotone scientific outcome curve. Complete all eight 25000-step trajectories, preserve physical model and sampling schedule, and satisfy both statistical energy-summary equivalence tests. Compute budgets are prospective reporting coordinates, not instructions to truncate or extend trajectories.

evaluation_inputs.generated_inputs: Use seeds 1000..1007 for both setVelocitiesToTemperature(300 K, seed) and LangevinMiddleIntegrator.setRandomNumberSeed(seed); same published coordinates for each replica. Eight replicas each run 25000 steps, collect energies every 250 steps, total simulated duration 0.8 ns.

evidence_limits: Margins summarize baseline across-seed sampling uncertainty; no same-seed run-to-run variability was measured.
Only paired median energy-summary equivalence is assessed. This does not establish individual trajectory or full energy-series identity; reproduce output contains no full series.
Published 5000 ns/day anchor is reference only; anchors_scored.json has no acceptance anchors. It cannot calibrate scientific tolerance or fixed-work method speedup.
No gate scripts named: intake/EXECUTION.json gate_scripts is empty. No workloads, builds, searches or method implementation performed.

hardware_cost_basis.controls: Hold GPU model, driver 570.148.08, software and precision fixed. One visible GPU, no unrelated GPU workloads. MPS required for concurrency assumptions. Count full occupied-device process wall including initialization; CPU launch and merge included.

infeasible_methods.reason: One GPU available. Equal-GPU-second Amdahl/k bound = 1 with k=1, below 1.05.
Transfer fraction p=0.004033836583324443; k=2 gives Amdahl bound 1.002020994472381, below 1.05 even before launch and synchronization overhead.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair candidate and baseline by input and identical velocity/integrator seed. For each metric and seed compute candidate minus baseline; use seed-level median difference across the five timing pairs, then exact two-sided order-statistic CI across eight seeds. Timing repetitions are not independent scientific seeds. Require every metric CI strictly inside its positive absolute margins. No exact or bitwise requirement. Seeds are independent random-stream design units; independence remains an assumption.

predicted_outcome.reason: Fixed-work benchmark: eight replicas, 25000 steps each; no calibrated energy-quality versus GPU-second curve. Budget does not authorize changing work.

outcome_vs_compute_points.uncertainty: Profile: kernels 58.2478999282%, CUDA API host time 41.3487164135%, H2D+D2H 0.4033836583%; GPU utilization unavailable. MPS throughput factors 1.3834956863 at two processes and 1.7633258236 at four processes are headroom measurements, not candidate gains. Dispatch the eight fixed seeded replicas in two waves of four workers sharing one GPU under MPS. Worker launch, duplicated input/system loading, H2D/D2H and ordered result merge may consume headroom; no new simulation inputs or extra replicas. Prospective overhead assumption: actual completion time is ideal bounded completion time multiplied by 1+h, h in [0.15, 0.65]. Thus speedup interval = bound/(1+h). Overheads include launch/transfer/merge; h is unmeasured and interval is not a statistical confidence interval. No candidate measurements, time-to-scientific-target observations, full energy series, or paired-difference variance are available. Energy equivalence must be measured using sealed paired seeds and margins.

protocol_cost.arithmetic: (warmup 1 + repetitions 5) * 2 arms * 116.82958263599994 s = 1401.9549916319993 s per complete performance scorer. No additional compute-curve runs because equal_outcome_target.not_applicable=true.
protocol_cost.limitation: Projection depends on explicit startup allowance; actual process-wall cost remains unavailable until adapter smoke. Budget is per complete scorer, not the sum of independent evaluations for all menu methods.

power.assumptions: Conditional design assumption, not measured power: independently across seeds, probability that BOTH seed-level paired metric differences fall strictly within their sealed margins is at least 0.99. Then probability all eight satisfy both margins is at least 0.99^8 = 0.9227446944; this sufficient event makes both min/max CIs pass. Baseline has no candidate paired differences, so unconditional power and effect-size calibration are unavailable. No post hoc margin or seed changes.

scheduling_details: Warmup arms and each of five timing pairs ordered using fixed seeded randomization. Each pair runs baseline and candidate consecutively on the same GPU without inter-arm overlap. Pair complete invocations; hold environment constant. Fixed seed identifiers determine scientific pairing independently of execution order.

splits.design: Fixed benchmark evaluation; no training or tuning split. All eight seeds already observed in baseline, so no claim of held-out generalization. No adaptive input/seed selection.

timing_scope.description: One complete invocation from process launch to exit, all eight seeded replicas at fixed steps. Includes interpreter/imports, PDB/XML loading, system and context construction, CUDA compilation, worker launch, H2D/D2H, integration, all energy queries, result merge, serialization and teardown. Adapter synchronizes GPU before completion. Package installation excluded.

warmup_protocol: One complete untimed invocation per arm with all sealed inputs and seeds, same fixed workload and process scope. Retain warmup cost in evaluation projection. No shortened simulation or omitted initialization. Timed invocations use fresh processes; no selective repetition removal.
